column1: # frontmatter to .claude/commands/<name>.md so each command exposes a
# description in the slash-command picker, an argument hint in autocomplete,
# and an explicit tool allowlist. Without frontmatter the commands still
# register (filename becomes the command name) but show no metadata.
# Leave argument_hint blank for commands that take no arguments — the
# renderer omits the argument-hint line in that case.
# Add a row whenever a new canonical command is added under
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Defaults applied when a command has no row in this file:
#   description   = Run the <command_name> playbook from canonical Infrastructure guidance.

column4: Format a citation from natural-language source information using EIG citation rules. Returns the formatted citation, inferred source type, and any missing required fields.
Generate an EIG publication cover sheet from a project description. Fills known fields, infers safe defaults, and marks unresolved items as [TO FILL].

Run all five RA reviews concurrently (code errors, methodology, AI skeptic, document numbers, document-code consistency) on a target project and write five self-contained HTML reports to <target-dir>/review-reports/.

Add a paper, data dictionary, codebook, or technical note to the literature catalog under Infrastructure/references/literature/. Enforces required fields, stores the artifact, and updates the catalog index.
Run the repository maintenance sweep (generated-copy drift, internal path integrity, literature catalog, freshness signals) and report prioritized actions.

Create and run a dependency-aware execution plan for a multi-step task, routing workstreams to specialist agents per Infrastructure/AI_WORKFLOW.md. Replans after each wave until completion criteria are met.
Run the AI skeptic review on a target project: spawns the ai-skeptic sub-agent and writes ai-skeptic-report.html to <target-dir>/review-reports/. Does not require a successful pipeline run first.
Run the code error review on a target project: spawns the code-reviewer sub-agent and writes code-error-report.html to <target-dir>/review-reports/.
Run the document-code consistency review on a target project: spawns the conceptual-consistency-reviewer sub-agent and writes doc-consistency-report.html to <target-dir>/review-reports/.
Run the methodology review on a target project: spawns the methodology-reviewer sub-agent and writes methodology-report.html to <target-dir>/review-reports/.
Run the document number verification review on a target project: spawns the data-consistency-reviewer sub-agent and writes doc-number-report.html to <target-dir>/review-reports/.
Audit a document or passage against EIG writing, citation, and figure-style rules using eig-reviewer behavior. Returns a structured issue list with concrete fixes.
Rewrite text using Smart Brevity principles while keeping EIG writing conventions. Returns the rewrite plus a short change log explaining what was tightened and why.
